Results.ReviewText: Love the grill-- perfect size for us. Able to grill 16 half-pound burgers (hand-formed) at once. Quality is good and I like the design. The iGrill add-on is super useful & makes it a lot easier to grill while hosting / able to hang out-- I do wish it would give you a notification on when to flip, that way you could totally multitask but hey it's grilling. I got the cover and I expect this to last several years with routine cleaning and maintenance.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is so much better than my previous one (another brand)! It actually cooks food in a reasonable length of time and is easy to control. My only criticism is that the burners could have had their own autostarts, instead of having to light from the first burner, but that is really minor. It's interesting that the dimensions of my 3 burner Weber are about the same as the two burner Brand X, so it fits well on my condo deck (with one shelf folded down).
Results.Title: Very good grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Porcelain-coated grates and flavorizer bars had rusted from being set up outside near the beach.  The ten year bumper-to-bumper warranty seemed to good to be true, but all I did was call Weber and explained what I needed and they got my grill registered and promptly sent out replacements, no questions asked.  They were pleasant to deal with and competent, and it couldn't have been easier.  That kind of excellent customer service is hard to find nowadays.  I am thoroughly satisfied.
Results.Title: Exemplary customer service and warranty coverage

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
